prompt: How old would James Logan have been when the estate of his descendent donated Neshaminy State Park land to the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania?
answer: James Logan was born in 1674. In 1956, when his descendant Robert R. Logan’s estate donated the land, Logan would have been **about 282 years old**—though he had died in 1751.
